title: observer: use epoch values from <wsutil/epochs.h>.
description:
Observer uses the 2000-01-01 00:00:00 UTC epoch; don't define the
value ourselves, use the `#define` from <wsutil/epochs.h>.

Also:

- refer to UTC rather than GMT;
- 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC is the UNIX/POSIX epoch, not something we
  invented;
- when writing, treat all time stamps prior to the epoch used by
  Observer the same - it's not clear why 1969 should be treated
  differently from 1999 (other than somebody from the city in which
  Network Instruments was headquartered having written a song about
  1999).
